lines: #You can lose money and earn it *back.*
You can lose a job and find *another.*
But time? Time never comes *back.*
#Every day you spend waiting is a day you'll never see *again.*
Every year you stay where you don't belong is a year *gone.*
We treat time like it's *unlimited.*
We say *someday.* We say *next year.*
As if next year is *promised.*
#It isn't.
The people who build great lives aren't *luckier.*
They just understood earlier that the clock is *running.*
So they stopped wasting it on things that don't *matter.*
On people who drain them. On fear. On *scrolling.*
Arguments that didn't matter. Worries that never *happened.*
Hours given to things you won't even *remember.*
#So ask yourself tonight. Where is my time *going?*
Is it building the life I want, or just *passing?*
You can't get today back.
But you can decide what tomorrow is *for.*
#Spend it like it's *precious.*
Because it *is.*
end: Send this to someone who keeps saying someday.

TIME.

post.title: You Can Earn Money Back. Not Time.
post.caption: Time is the only thing you can never get back. ⏳ Spend it on what matters.
post.first_comment: What would you do if you had one more free hour every day? 👇
